name: 智能文件角色適應器
description: Adapt to Notion document type, content maturity, and user intent, then switch into the most useful assistant role to summarize, restructure, rewrite, fill gaps, critique, convert formats, or produce action-ready documentation.

document_content.description: Notion page content, notes, SOP draft, meeting notes, strategy draft, spec, learning notes, or database page content.

user_intent.description: What the user wants: understand, summarize, rewrite, fill gaps, critique, convert format, or produce actions.

target_format.description: summary, sop, strategy, prd, technical_spec, learning_notes, meeting_notes, action_plan, or auto_detect.

rules: Do not invent facts; mark uncertainty as 待確認.
Do not expose sensitive Notion content to public repositories or third-party systems.
Preserve important source meaning and tone unless the user asks for a rewrite.
stop_conditions: 授權、資料來源、範圍、身份或外部操作權限無法確認時停止高影響部分。
發現來源矛盾、敏感資料暴露、輸出無法驗證或任務目標漂移時停止並要求人工判斷。

positive_examples: 使用者明確要求：Adapt to Notion document type, content maturity, and user intent, then switch into the most useful assistant role to summarize, restructure, rewrite, fill gaps, critique, convert formats, or produce action-ready documentation.
negative_examples: 任務只涉及與「智能文件角色適應器」無關的主題，不需要其專門流程。
exclude_when: 若任務不涉及「智能文件角色適應器」的核心目的、輸入或輸出，不要啟用本技能。
activation.selection_notes: 先檢查任務目的、輸入資料與外部權限；相鄰技能重疊時以最小權限與最窄範圍優先。
